sections.text_helper: Section 24.6.12 "RTC timestamp sub second register (RTC_TSSSR)" in chapter 24 (Real-time clock (RTC)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 671.
sections.section_content:
The content of this register is valid only when TSF is set to 1 in RTC_SR. It is cleared when
the TSF bit is reset.
Address offset: 0x38
Power-on reset value: 0x0000 0000
System reset: not affected
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 SS[15:0]: Sub second value
SS[15:0] is the value of the synchronous prescaler counter when the timestamp event
occurred.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: SS[15:0]
fields.description: Sub second value SS[15:0] is the value of the synchronous prescaler counter when the timestamp event occurred.
